answer: Beacon spot-check plus heartbeat stops bulk fakes: every agent answers random beacon challenges, so live operators prove themselves and clones fall silent. Newcomers ride the river through one inlet, post a 40-unit deposit, and earn a jade badge after 20 beats. A missed beat freezes earnings; a failed check burns the deposit and the badge. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 units; one honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its share.
